title: SHORE: Stability-Hybrid On-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Online Bin Packing
abstract: arXiv:2611.08364v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Online 3D bin packing with a processing buffer requires choosing which box to pack, its orientation, and its placement while keeping the stack stable under unknown future arrivals. A collapse ends the episode and forfeits the remaining volume. Existing methods use geometric rules or hard stability masks, limiting how risk can influence the joint choice of box, orientation, and placement. We propose Stability-Hybrid On-Policy Reinforcement Learning (SHORE), which combines a learned stability probability of a placement with an on-policy estimate of its return conditional on stability. A 3D U-Net learns stability from executed outcomes and simulated alternatives, revealing outcomes of actions underrepresented in early rollouts. A discrete on-policy actor--critic uses stability predictions in both its action values and policy prior, with gates that limit the effect of an untrained or changing model. translated_title: SHORE：面向在线装箱问题的稳定性混合在策略强化学习
translated_abstract: 带处理缓冲区的在线三维装箱问题需要在未知未来货物到达的情况下，选择要装载的箱子、其朝向以及放置位置，同时保持堆叠体的稳定性。一旦发生倒塌，回合即终止并损失剩余装载体积。现有方法依赖几何规则或硬稳定性掩码，限制了风险因素对箱子、朝向与放置位置联合决策的影响。我们提出稳定性混合在策略强化学习方法（SHORE），它将学习到的放置稳定性概率与以稳定性为条件的在策略收益估计相结合。其中，一个3D U-Net通过已执行的结果和模拟的替代方案学习稳定性，从而揭示早期滚动采样中代表性不足的动作的真实结果。一个离散的在策略actor-critic将稳定性预测同时用于其动作价值和策略先验中，并通过门控机制限制未训练或持续变化的模型所带来的影响。在部署阶段，SHORE不需要额…（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SHORE方法，通过3D U-Net学习稳定性概率并结合在策略收益估计，将稳定性风险融入箱子选择、朝向和放置位置的联合决策中，有效解决了在线三维装箱中防止倒塌与最大化装载量的权衡问题。
